name: educlaw-ielts-planner
description: EduClaw - Personal IELTS Study Secretary: automated planning, Google Calendar scheduling via gcalcli, unique lesson plans per session, Google Sheet progress tracking, Discord notifications, bilingual support (EN/VI).
author: moclaw

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Google Gemini API key — used to generate unique lesson content for each study session.

env.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
env.description: Google API key (Custom Search JSON API) — used to fetch study resource URLs during session research.

env.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_JSON
env.description: Path to Google OAuth 2.0 client JSON file — required by gcalcli to authenticate with Google Calendar.

env.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: Discord bot token — used to send study reminders and progress notifications to a Discord channel.

env.name: DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID
env.description: Discord channel ID where notifications are sent.

env.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: Telegram bot token — optional, enables Telegram notifications as an alternative to Discord.

config.description: Path to the OpenClaw workspace directory where IELTS_STUDY_PLAN.md and tracker/educlaw.db are stored.

data.description: Markdown file that accumulates the full IELTS study plan across sessions.
Local SQLite database tracking completed sessions, band-score progress, and study hours.
Google OAuth credentials file created and used by gcalcli.

network.purpose: Read/write Google Calendar events via gcalcli.
Call Gemini API to generate lesson plans.
Fetch study resource URLs via Google Custom Search API.
Send study reminders and progress notifications via Discord bot.
Optional: send notifications via Telegram bot.
